heading: ## Acceptance Criteria
expected:
- [ ] Ordinary mixed-history delivery remains blocked without a valid scoped exception. <!-- aitm-verified vc-list="vc:1" -->
- [ ] An explicit host-verified user authorization maps every excepted source commit and produces deterministic delivery attribution for an unchanged operation. <!-- aitm-verified vc-list="vc:1" -->
- [ ] Invalid authority, scope, inventory, mappings, expiry, revocation, supersession, and reuse fail closed while unrelated delivery gates remain enforced. <!-- aitm-verified vc-list="vc:1" -->
- [ ] Delivery receipts truthfully identify authorized attribution exceptions and preserve audit provenance. <!-- aitm-verified vc-list="vc:1" -->
- [ ] CLI help and operator documentation cover preparation and explicit activation; package build and complete local suite pass. <!-- aitm-verified vc-list="vc:2" -->
replacement:
- [ ] An open PR with mixed source attribution remains blocked without one active exact exception; ordinary and historical delivery paths retain their current behavior. <!-- aitm-verified vc-list="vc:1" -->
- [ ] Two-pass preparation and a verified Codex user message bind exact repository, PR, head, ordered inventory digest, operation, and one issue mapping per parser-rejected source SHA; unchanged evaluation produces deterministic attribution. <!-- aitm-verified vc-list="vc:1" -->
- [ ] Invalid authority, local object proof, scope, inventory, mappings, expiry, revocation, competing revisions, drift, or cross-operation reuse fail closed while unrelated delivery gates remain enforced. <!-- aitm-verified vc-list="vc:1" -->
- [ ] Waived v2 intent, v3 receipt, and merge verification identify the exact exception and preserve truthful audit provenance; legacy record schemas remain readable. <!-- aitm-verified vc-list="vc:1" -->
- [ ] CLI help and operator documentation explain preparation, Codex authorization, record/revise/revoke, and retry; package smoke and complete local verification pass. <!-- aitm-verified vc-list="vc:2" -->
